source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第三课, typed from 练习册A pp. 16–29 (PDF index = printed + 4, verified on p. 16). Same shapes as L05: tf/order/slots/match/sort are marked by rule; write is judged stroke by stroke; free is grid writing for the chinese-review skill; read is recorded; the four-choice exercises are `blocks` naming zh-word items. Left out because no type fits, with their keys so a type can be added: 星期二 练习2 (p. 19–20, choose the word for a picture, two options each: (1) 石桥 (2) 狮子 (3) 站立 (4) 绿草); 星期三 练习2 (p. 22, color the correct word, two options each: (1) 终于 (2) 中心 (3) 生动 (4) 景色 (5) 栏杆); 星期四 练习2 (p. 24–25, answer by choosing A or B: (1) A 我去了北京颐和园 (2) A 有昆明湖、十七孔桥和长廊 (3) B 因为有十七个桥洞 (4) B 登上万寿山); 星期四 练习4 (p. 26, draw a sketch map of the visit — a drawing, not writing). A two-choice `pick` type with the book's own options per item would take the first three. 星期五 练习3 (pp. 27–28, 读一读《故宫》, a passage of the workbook's own) is left out: the site holds no text of the book, by the owner's decision of 2 October (docs/chinese.md § 8); she reads it from the workbook, and a reading of it can be recorded under 阅读 once a note assigns it.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The book offers five words (景色 小岛 长廊 生动 石柱) for the five blanks of one passage. Each item carries four of them — the one left off is the word the sentence's grammar already rules out — so the task she faces is the book's: which of the bank fills this blank.

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.en: 颐和园 — yí, the Summer Palace.
很久 — jiǔ, a long time.
站着 — zhàn, standing.
小桥 — qiáo, a small bridge.
长廊 — láng, the long corridor.
眼睛 — yǎn, eye.
长寿 — shòu, long life.
收到 — shōu, receive.

exercises.title: 左右结构、半包围结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, half-enclosed, or a single-body character?
exercises.scope_note: The book lists eight characters under three structures. 寿 is left out of the sorting: dictionaries file it as 上下结构, a group the book does not offer here, so which of the three the book intends cannot be read off the page. A wrong key is worse than a missing item. 寿 is still written in zx:L03-D1-01w.

explanation.zh: 臣在左、页在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 臣 on the left, 页 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 久不能拆成两部分：独体字。
explanation.en: 久 cannot be split into parts: a single-body character.

explanation.zh: 立在左、占在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 立 on the left, 占 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 木在左、乔在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 木 on the left, 乔 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 广从上面和左面包住郎：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 广 wraps 郎 from the top and the left: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 目在左、艮在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 目 on the left, 艮 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 丩在左、攵在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 丩 on the left, 攵 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 根据图片提示写汉字
exercises.title_en: Use the picture clues to write characters

note.zh: 图在练习册第17页，四张：左上、右上、左下、右下。看图和拼音，写出那个字。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 17: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. Look at the picture and the pinyin, and write the character.

explanation.en: The picture shows two feet: 脚 jiǎo.

explanation.zh: 图上是一座有很多桥洞的桥：桥 qiáo。
explanation.en: The picture shows a bridge with many arches: 桥 qiáo.
The picture shows a stone lion: 狮 shī.

explanation.zh: 图上是一只眼睛：眼 yǎn。
explanation.en: The picture shows an eye: 眼 yǎn.

note.zh: 先点上面的部件，再点下面能和它合成字的那一半。课本已连好一组：立—占。
note.en: Tap a part on the top row, then the half below that makes a character with it. The book has drawn one line already: 立—占.

explanation.en: 氵 and 同 make 洞.
木 and 乔 make 桥.
广 and 郎 make 廊.

explanation.zh: 立和占合成"站"——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 立 and 占 make 站 — the book's own example.

exercises.title: 连一连，写一写：把字写出来
exercises.title_en: Match and write: write the characters

explanation.en: 立 on the left, 占 on the right: 站.
氵 on the left, 同 on the right: 洞.
木 on the left, 乔 on the right: 桥.

explanation.zh: 广在上面和左面，郎在里面：廊。
explanation.en: 广 over the top and down the left, 郎 inside: 廊.

note.zh: 两个字读音相近，各组一个词。
note.en: The two sound alike; make one word with each.

exercises.title: 根据拼音写词语，并填在合适的句子中
exercises.title_en: Write the words below Pinyin and fill in the appropriate sentences

note.zh: 五个拼音：zhōngxīn　jǐngsè　lǜsè　zhōngyú　xiǎodǎo。想出是哪五个词，把合适的那个写进句子的格子里；第（2）句要填两个。
note.en: Five pinyin words: zhōngxīn, jǐngsè, lǜsè, zhōngyú, xiǎodǎo. Work out the five words and write the one that fits into each sentence's cells; sentence (2) takes two.

items.prompt_en: (2) 你快看，湖＿＿还有一个＿＿！ (two words)

items.prompt: （4）这次作文比赛，我＿＿取得了第一名。
items.prompt_en: (4) 这次作文比赛，我＿＿取得了第一名。

exercises.title: 照例子，用"终于"完成句子
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to complete the sentences with "zhōngyú"

items.prompt: 例：今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。（1）＿＿，＿＿终于＿＿。
items.prompt_en: Example: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。 (1) …，…终于…。

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：我终于来到了颐和园。
explanation.en: In order: 我终于来到了颐和园 — I finally arrived at the Summer Palace.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：颐和园的景色十分美丽。
explanation.en: In order: 颐和园的景色十分美丽 — the Summer Palace's scenery is very beautiful.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：湖中心有个小岛。
explanation.en: In order: 湖中心有个小岛 — in the middle of the lake there is an island.

exercises.title: 请用中文写出你周末想要去的五个地方
exercises.title_en: List five places you want to visit on weekends in Chinese

exercises.title: 读一读

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
中心 湖中心 广场中心 文化中心
十分美丽 十分生动 十分可爱 十分难忘
绿色 红色 白色 蓝色
小桥 孔桥 桥洞 一座桥

exercises.title: 根据句子选择正确的图片
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct pictures for the sentences

note.zh: 四张图在练习册第22页，标着A、B、C、D。先点句子，再点它说的那张图。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 22, lettered A to D. Tap a sentence, then the picture it describes.

left: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。
从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。
桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。
走在著名的长廊上，绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆，一眼望不到头。

items.left: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。

explanation.zh: 来到颐和园——图D是挂着"颐和园"牌子的大门。
explanation.en: Arriving at the Summer Palace — picture D is the gate with the 颐和园 plaque.

items.left: 从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。

explanation.zh: 十七孔桥——图C是有很多桥洞的长石桥。
explanation.en: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge — picture C is the long stone bridge with many arches.

items.left: 桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。

explanation.en: The little stone lions on the pillars — picture A.

items.left: 走在著名的长廊上，绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆，一眼望不到头。

explanation.en: The long corridor with green pillars and red railings — picture B.

exercises.title: 读课文，回答问题
exercises.title_en: Read the text and answer the questions

items.prompt_en: (1) Where did the writer go this winter vacation?
(2) Going in by the east gate, what did the writer see?
(3) What is in the middle of the lake?

items.prompt: （4）十七孔桥两边的石柱上有什么？
items.prompt_en: (4) What is on the stone pillars at the two sides of the Seventeen-Arch Bridge?

exercises.title: 选择相应的语句补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct expressions to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，看练习册第25页的地图选。
note.en: Four lines are missing; use the map on workbook p. 25 to choose.

options: 你先向前走，第一个路口左转

items.before: 大卫：______，我想问一下，去学校怎么走？

explanation.zh: 开口问路先打招呼：您好，我想问一下……
explanation.en: You greet before you ask the way: 您好，我想问一下…

items.before: 老王：我看看啊！我们在这里……　大卫：对。　老王：我知道了。______

explanation.zh: 老王告诉他去学校的路：你先向前走，第一个路口左转。地图上红线就是这么走的。
explanation.en: Lao Wang gives the way to the school: go straight first, then turn left at the first crossing — the red line on the map.

items.before: 大卫：好的。我还想买点儿东西，______？

explanation.zh: 想买东西，就问商场怎么走。
explanation.en: He wants to buy something, so he asks the way to the mall: 请问商场怎么走？

items.before: 老王：一直向前走就可以了。

explanation.en: After being shown the way, you thank the person: 谢谢您。

exercises.title: 听一听，根据问题判断句子正误
exercises.title_en: Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第82页第3课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再判断对错。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 3 listening script on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording), then mark each sentence.

exercises.script_note: The dialogue, typed from the appendix 听力文本 for 第3课 on 练习册A p. 82, so a parent can read it aloud; the publisher's recording is a download from jnupress.com. The site does not render this field yet. The dialogue itself is on 练习册A p. 82 (附录 听力文本) for a parent to read aloud; it is not kept here, under the same hold as every text of the book.

explanation.en: The boy says 今天天气很好 — the weather is good.

explanation.zh: 男生说：我们去公园野餐吧！
explanation.en: The boy suggests it: 我们去公园野餐吧！

items.text: 他们没有去公园野餐，因为中午太热了。

explanation.zh: 女生说：好是好，但是中午太热了！所以改去看电影。
explanation.en: The girl says 中午太热了 — it is too hot at noon — so they change the plan to a movie.

explanation.zh: 男生说去看电影，女生说好啊，先去看看有没有票。
explanation.en: The boy proposes a movie and the girl agrees, if there are tickets.

exercises.title: 选词填空（1）：完、玩、晚
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (1)

note.zh: 三个字读音相近，每句用一个。点句子，再点填进去的字。
note.en: Three characters that sound alike, one per sentence. Tap a sentence, then the character that goes in it.

left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

items.left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

explanation.en: 玩游戏 — play a game: 玩.
这么晚了 — it is so late: 晚.

explanation.zh: 写完作业：完 wán，做完了。
explanation.en: 写完作业 — finished the homework: 完.

exercises.title: 选词填空（2）：坐、左、做
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (2)

explanation.en: 左边 — the left side: 左.
坐下来 — sit down: 坐.
怎么做 — how to do it: 做.

exercises.title: 选词填空（3）：狮、是、师
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (3)
left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.zh: 这位是我的妈妈：是 shì。
explanation.en: 这位是我的妈妈 — this is my mother: 是.

items.left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.en: 狮子 — lion: 狮.
老师 — teacher: 师.

exercises.title: 介绍一个你最感兴趣的景点（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Write about a scenic spot that interests you the most, with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：（1）你最想去的地方叫什么名字？（2）那个地方有什么景点？（3）有什么吸引你的地方？（4）你想和哪些人一起去？
note.en: Prompts: (1) What is the place you most want to visit called? (2) What is there to see? (3) What draws you to it? (4) Who would you go with?

items.prompt: 写一写这个景点（四十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write about the place (more than 40 characters).
